title: Three waves — the timing record
description: Instagram portrait: the three waves of negative coverage as banded cards, with his withdrawal-statement timing quote beneath.
alt_text: Portrait dark card titled “Three waves.” Three banded cards: Wave 1, Oct–Nov 2025, Reddit posts and the tattoo, 12 stories in the heaviest month; Wave 2, May–Jun 2026, texts and dating history, the week before the June 9 primary; Wave 3, Jul 2026, the assault allegation, before the July 13 ballot deadline. Beneath, in italics: “There is a reason that this is happening now.” — his withdrawal statement.
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Social card for The Platner Record documentation site. Restrained archival styling; figures from official Maine SOS results and the site’s sourced ledgers. Attribution metadata is also embedded in the PNG as tEXt chunks (Author, Copyright, Title, Description).
